author: UneCookie
body:
Hello, after being banned a second time (which I understand) I was told I could appeal again.


The main reason I am appealing again Is for Avicus Christmas; being banned for Christmas from Avicus I feel is like having all my Christams presents taken away from me, awful! In addition to this, the holidays are my only true free time where I can play on Avicus without having to go every 5 seconds which is Heaven to me, I would love to be able to celebrate Christmas with all of my friends on Avicus and I do feel not being allowed to do so is a bit harsh, hence why I would be grateful beyond words if I could be unbanned. I don't want to make a big deal out of it so I wont put this on the archives but I'm having a hard time in real life and Minecraft on Avicus is ever so good for relieving my stress as it helps me socialise in ways I find hard to in real life. I am currently under a lot of pressure at my school and would love to forget about it all over the holidays so an unban would literally be the best thing ever. I would love to be back on the network and to spend another great year  with everyone if possible.

                                                       With regards, aFgt

replies.body: P.S. If im not unbanned would love to wish everyone merry xmas and happy new year :)

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Sorry, but we can't accept an appeal solely off of personal reasoning. As much as it'd mean, doing so would be biased and unfair compared to other users. Maintaining a fair environment, I cannot make a special exception to unban you from a legitimate infraction.

If you have any concerns to voice, email support@avicus.net.
